scenes.spoken_text: Complementary materials serve different roles. Separate upholstery, cushioning, surfaces and supports, then review the actual products, their interfaces and maintenance requirements.
scenes.caption: Complementary materials serve different roles. Separate upholstery, cushioning, surfaces and supports, then review the actual products, their interfaces and maintenance requirements.

scenes.spoken_text: In an upholstered seat, specify cover, liner, filling, support and frame separately. Request fabric identification, intended use and cleaning instructions, filling data and a seating sample. A fabric colour or one foam property is not a complete comfort specification. Review the assembly and whether covers can be maintained or replaced.
scenes.caption: Each layer has a role; assess the assembly together.

scenes.spoken_text: For glass or stone on a metal base, identify the product, dimensions, support and connection system. Request edge, protection and joint details for the selected assembly. Do not infer thickness or capacity from a photograph. Obtain supplier data and technical review, including installation access and possible disassembly.
scenes.caption: The material interface needs a reviewed connection detail.

scenes.spoken_text: Link each surface to its use environment and declared care method, considering liquids, abrasion and light exposure. Record product limits instead of a general durability claim. Review samples according to supplier instructions and identify replaceable parts. Deliver material codes and care information so maintenance does not depend on guesswork.
scenes.caption: Care records belong to identified products.

scenes.spoken_text: A client selects a chair from an appealing photograph. Filling, support and removable-cover details are unknown. Daily use and frequent cleaning require evidence beyond the image. Decision: request layer specifications, care information and a seating sample before approving the upholstery system.
scenes.caption: Decision: request layer specifications, care information and a seating sample before approving the upholstery system.
